metadata.title: IAU J2000 constellation boundaries for Star Atlas
metadata.method: Boundary coordinates are downloaded from the TXT links in the IAU table. Declination ranges are minima and maxima of the published boundary vertices. Northern/southern/equator regions are derived from these ranges.
metadata.visibilityMethod: At geographic latitude phi, a declination d can rise above an ideal unobstructed horizon when abs(phi-d) < 90 degrees. Compare the constellation declination range with (phi-90, phi+90) for none, partial, or full geometric visibility at some sidereal time. This does not promise nighttime visibility on a given date, or account for terrain, weather, atmospheric refraction or light pollution.
metadata.caution: Ranges are rounded representations from the published J2000 boundary vertices, not high-precision interpolations of curved boundary edges. At a limiting latitude use the official chart and a local sky simulation.
